# Spot-light

> A browser game: Spot, a two-year-old black labrador with a red collar, chases a red laser dot that the player steers with the mouse or arrow keys. One self-contained index.html plus three.js r149. MIT licence.

- Modes: Dodge (60 seconds, 3 lives, keep the dot away), Endless (count catches), Lure (steer Spot into a cup, a sock and a ball).
- Views: 2D top-down or 3D (three.js); Normal or 8-bit style. V and B switch, Esc pauses.
- No network requests besides Google Fonts; no data stored.
